facts.fact: 一行人天亮后离开黑岩，Mearna 放慢马速，与孩子们并骑同行
facts.anchor: They left the Black Crags early the following morning

facts.fact: Vedra 说自己做了恶梦，梦见一个灰色、眼睛发亮、没有形状的东西从洞里出来跟着他们
facts.anchor: I dreamed that something gray, with bright eyes and no shape

facts.fact: Vedra 听出 Diarban 说“到 Dun Ard 之前”，当场追问，说 Daley 不会去 Dun Ard
facts.anchor: Daley’s not going to Dun Ard

facts.fact: 说话的人交代到了 Tethtain 的城堡要寸步不离男孩 Daley，男孩是带所有人平安回家的关键
facts.anchor: He will be the key to getting you all back home safely

facts.fact: 说话的人承认图书馆那场险情该怪自己，但正因如此不能派她带琥珀走
facts.anchor: I could not send you off with the Amber

facts.fact: 洗净的琥珀像从日星边缘崩下来的一块碎片，被穿上皮绳挂到 Daley 脖子上
facts.anchor: like a splinter broken from the edge of the daystar

facts.fact: Vedra 张开双臂的动作让 Daley 强烈想起母亲常做的动作，他最后还是让她抱住了自己
facts.anchor: it reminded him so strongly of something his mother used to do

facts.fact: 王子答应会尽力守住这份托付
facts.anchor: I will do my best to keep that trust, mistress
